audience: e-commerce teams that handle returns, refunds and exchanges in ReturnLogic

useCases.title: Find returns that need action
useCases.text: Count the returns that require action, then list them by status, return type or date range.

useCases.title: Review one return and its history
useCases.text: Open one return to see its comments, items, reasons and timeline. Read the return-type changes of one item.

useCases.title: Look up an order and its customer
useCases.text: Find an order by number or customer email, then read its items, addresses and statuses, and the customer record.

useCases.title: Check products and return categories
useCases.text: Look up products by SKU and read their variants. List the product categories that return rules use.

useCases.title: Flag a return for the team
useCases.text: Flag a return with an optional comment, so the team can filter for it. A flag cannot be removed, and nothing is sent to the customer.

useCases.title: Mark return items received
useCases.text: Record the warehouse receipt of return items. When every item is received, the store may process the return automatically.
